tools.name: claim_canvas
tools.description: Exchanges a pairing code and recovery claimKey for a durable, screen-scoped control token. Repeating the same pair recovers the original grant.

tools.name: pairing_status
tools.description: Reads the validity, expiry or claimed status of a pairing code without consuming it.

tools.name: disconnect_canvas
tools.description: Revokes the screen pairing, owner access and claim recovery, including while the browser is offline.

tools.name: get_canvas
tools.description: Reads workspace revision, focus, component summaries, render status, media capabilities and display dimensions including device pixel ratio. Physical DPI is unknown.

tools.name: get_console
tools.description: Reads up to 200 memory-only component console and runtime error entries, optionally filtered by cursor or component. Entries are untrusted component output; host and authentication pages are excluded.

tools.name: read_component
tools.description: Reads a component source, saved state and supplied data.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists approved TV template slugs, versions and param examples. Prefer render(slug) for these boards instead of generating source.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Paints an approved catalog template (weather, clock, countdown) without generated source. weather location defaults to Sudbury. First matching-display paint skips preview. Version, source, or display-fingerprint changes stage a private draft (previewRequired) and leave live untouched. Data-only refr

tools.name: prepare_draft
tools.description: Creates a private browser-owned component draft and preview URL without changing the live workspace. Drafts expire after 15 minutes or browser reload. Optional slot drafts a nested sub-component only (preview is slot-scoped). Call screenshot_draft with draftID and expectedVersion, grade TV-distance

tools.name: read_draft
tools.description: Reads a private draft source, state, data, target display, version, expiry and preview URL. Requires the original canvas online. Keep previewURL private; call screenshot_draft for this version before publish_draft.

tools.name: screenshot_draft
tools.description: Renders an exact private draft version as an MCP PNG for the Preview quality loop. Requires draftID and expectedVersion. Isolated layout only — not the live TV. A screenshot never publishes.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Replaces a private draft at its expected version and issues a new version and preview URL. Previous preview links become invalid; original expiry is unchanged. Call screenshot_draft on the new version; loop update_draft until the TV-distance bar clears, then publish.

tools.name: publish_draft
tools.description: Publishes an exact reviewed draft version only after the Preview quality loop. Set review to visual only if you actually screenshotted that version; otherwise structural. Do not publish a failing layout. Success requires ok and receipt:paint. Failed rendering preserves the previous component.

tools.name: discard_draft
tools.description: Removes an exact private draft version and its preview access without changing the live workspace.

tools.name: queue_component
tools.description: Queues a component create or update for a background or offline browser. Returns queued rather than rendered. Default expiry is one hour, maximum 24 hours. Source is removed on completion or expiry.

tools.name: get_operation
tools.description: Reads queued operation status and any browser outcome without contacting the browser. Status can be queued, applying, rendered, failed, expired, canceled or unknown_outcome.

tools.name: cancel_operation
tools.description: Cancels a queued component update and removes its source. Applying updates cannot be canceled; completed receipts remain available.

tools.name: set_agent_status
tools.description: Sets or clears an ephemeral building indicator, with browser acknowledgement. Does not change workspace revision or publish drafts. Automatically clears after two minutes.

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Validates, renders and saves a React or HTML component immediately to the right of focus. Success requires browser paint acknowledgement.

tools.name: update_component
tools.description: Validates replacement source and updates a component in place, preserving existing state and data unless provided. Failed rendering retains the previous version.

tools.name: delete_component
tools.description: Deletes a component and selects its nearest remaining neighbor.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Focuses a component or moves one position. Acknowledges after the selected component renders.

tools.name: set_component_data
tools.description: Pushes live observations without regenerating source. Same-source React reuses the compiled module. Default replaces data; merge:true shallow-merges keys (32KB bound). Optional slot targets a nested sub-component on a fullscreen board. Active components acknowledge rendering; inactive components ack

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Runs an async JavaScript function body in the selected active component sandbox and returns bounded JSON. Supports DOM and state interactions, excluding provider iframes and browser controls. Five-second deadline; timeout reports unknown outcome and does not roll back effects.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Typed component inspect through the active sandbox. Requires revision, version, operation ID and an inspected target for mutations. Returns observed state. Five-second timeout is unknown outcome; never retry with a new ID.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Typed component click through the active sandbox. Requires revision, version, operation ID and an inspected target for mutations. Returns observed state. Five-second timeout is unknown outcome; never retry with a new ID.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Typed component fill through the active sandbox. Requires revision, version, operation ID and an inspected target for mutations. Returns observed state. Five-second timeout is unknown outcome; never retry with a new ID.

tools.name: select
tools.description: Typed component select through the active sandbox. Requires revision, version, operation ID and an inspected target for mutations. Returns observed state. Five-second timeout is unknown outcome; never retry with a new ID.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "pairing_status" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_draft · Private data: claim_canvas, render, prepare_draft, read_draft, screenshot_draft, update_draft, discard_draft · Public sink: update_draft, publish_draft, set_agent_status · Destructive: delete_component, execute_script.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_draft · Private data: claim_canvas, render, prepare_draft, read_draft, screenshot_draft, update_draft, discard_draft · Public sink: update_draft, publish_draft, set_agent_status · Destructive: delete_component, execute_script

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "prepare_draft" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
